scientific_limitations: Three-dimensional rectangular boxes with strictly positive orthogonal half-side lengths only.
No universal extremal statement for arbitrary convex bodies or nonorthogonal parallelotopes.
The absolute volume contains a universal convergent triple-disk mixed-volume integral, which cancels from the exact deficit.
Historical priority remains provisional; independent mathematical validation not performed.
title: Exact volume deficit and sharp cubic stability of mean-projection bodies of rectangular boxes
